notes: Timber REIT, not a typical financial firm; facets mostly do not fit, though it is classed as a REIT.

sub_sector.value: timberland REIT; softwood lumber manufacturing; rural real estate

financial_business_type.detail: Land resources real estate investment trust owning timberlands, producing lumber and selling real estate.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns from timber and log sales, lumber and plywood sales, and real estate sales, not financial revenue.

customer_type.detail: Sells logs and lumber products to wood products customers; sells land to real estate buyers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Asset-heavy owner of timberlands and mills, but not a financial risk-carrying business.
